exposure: Mode of delivery (vaginal birth or C-section)
Perception of support from medical staff
cohort: 140 Chinese mothers 1-10 days postpartum at three tertiary hospitals in China
finding: Women who had a vaginal birth reported higher levels of satisfaction compared to those who had a C-section, and perception of medical staff support mediated this relationship.
mod_finding: Women's self-assessed health moderated the relationship between mode of delivery and medical staff support.
